modmenu.summaryTranslation.salts_invento: Desktop-style inventory upgrades with expandable storage, movable windows, pins, resizing, and API hooks.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.salts_inv:
Salt's Inventory Update upgrades Minecraft's inventory workflow with expandable player storage, desktop-style movable container windows, pin and ghost-pin controls, resize and snapping options, and API hooks for supported inventory screens. Configure it with /saltsinventory config or the mod-list config button.

Discord: https://discord.gg/kfdE9gGGxP
API: https://salt-and-fries.github.io/Salt-s-Inventory-Update/
Source: https://github.com/Salt-and-Fries/Salt-s-Inventory-Update
Donate: https://www.paypal.com/donate/?business=ERE5F32WV4NWN&no_recurring=1&currency_code=USD
config.salts_inventory_update.title: Salt's Inventory Update Settings
config.salts_inventory_update.enable_mod: Turns Salt's Inventory Update gameplay features on or off. When off, vanilla inventory and container screens are used and Salt desktop networking stays inactive.
config.salts_inventory_update.expandable: Shows the add-slot button in the player inventory and creative inventory tab. Turning this off hides the button without deleting existing expanded inventory contents.
config.salts_inventory_update.return_hot: Places the hotbar below the player inventory and creative windows and the offhand slot in the character window. The normal HUD hotbar is hidden while any Salt window is open.
config.salts_inventory_update.window_ope: Controls where newly opened container windows appear before you move or pin them.
config.salts_inventory_update.open_unloc: Makes newly created unsaved windows start movable. Saved per-window lock states still take priority.
config.salts_inventory_update.allow_resi: Allows supported storage windows and API windows to be resized when they are unlocked.
config.salts_inventory_update.enable_win: When a resized window is released, trims extra empty space so the content grid fits cleanly. Disable this to keep exact resized dimensions.
config.salts_inventory_update.reset_lock: When a window is locked again, returns it to its default position and size while preserving its pin mode.
config.salts_inventory_update.enable_gho: Allows the pin button to cycle into Ghost Pinned mode. When disabled, the pin button skips ghost pins and existing ghost-pinned windows act like normal pinned windows.
config.salts_inventory_update.persistent: Clears windows from the screen instead of closing them when E is held or Esc is pressed, then restores them the next time a Salt window opens.
config.salts_inventory_update.minimizabl: Shows the minimize button on Salt windows. When off, windows stay expanded and the minimize control is hidden.
config.salts_inventory_update.open_inven: Open Inventory When Containers Are Opened
Automatically opens the player inventory window when a visible container window opens.
config.salts_inventory_update.ghost_wind: Controls how visible ghost-pinned window previews are when rendered over the world.
config.salts_inventory_update.e_hold_clo: How long E must be held to close all Salt windows. The close-all popup appears after one quarter of this time.
config.salts_inventory_update.enable_det: Adds verbose Salt desktop logs for container capture, window rendering, slot rendering, API/custom windows, and packet flow while debugging mod pack issues.
config.salts_inventory_update.force_cont: Opens a registry-driven list of every known menu container. Checked entries are forced through Salt's desktop window path, including vanilla menus changed by other mods and modded menu types.
config.salts_inventory_update.runtime_di: Disabled for this server because Salt desktop networking is unavailable.
config.salts_inventory_update.recipe_bro: Set as default recipe browser tab
instructions.salts_inventory_update.desk: Welcome to the new and improved inventory experience!
If you do not want to read this now, simply close this window.
Your inventory and opened containers now appear as windows.
You can keep multiple windows open and move items between them for easier inventory management.
Use /saltsinventory help to open this window again at any time.
instructions.salts_inventory_update.cont: Give the mouse to camera control, or use the hotbar with no windows open
instructions.salts_inventory_update.wind: Unlock a window to drag it around the screen and place it wherever feels best.
If resizing is enabled in settings, supported windows can be resized by dragging their bottom-right corner.
If following is not displayed, decrease the §lGUI Scale§r or increase the game resolution.
Focus: Shift-clicked items move directly into the focused window when possible.
Pin: Saves this window's position for the next time it opens. Click to pin or unpin.
Lock: Prevents the window from being moved or resized. Click to lock or unlock.
Link: Select another highlighted window to make linked windows open and close together.
Minimize: Collapses the window into a title bar to keep your screen less cluttered.
instructions.salts_inventory_update.inve: Move items in and out of your hotbar by dragging them between the hotbar and other inventory slots.
Enable Return Hotbar to Inventory in settings to place it below Inventory and Creative and move the offhand slot into Character.
If enabled in settings, you can spend XP levels to purchase extra inventory slots.
Purchased slots stay with your player and behave like normal inventory storage.
Open the recipe browser as a Salt window
Search ingredients, recipes, uses, favorites, and recent items.
Hover lookups for recipes and uses
Move Items works with compatible Salt crafting windows.
instructions.salts_inventory_update.toms: Storage and crafting terminals open as Salt windows.
Terminal search, sorting, and recipes stay inside the window.
Filters, inventory links, level emitters, and filing cabinets
use Salt layouts when Tom's Simple Storage is installed.
